coreIdea: Dry-run C code line by line with a variable table. Static variables persist across calls. Watch pre/post-increment, integer division, unsigned wraparound.

patternRecognitionTable.seeThis: static variable inside a repeatedly-called function
blank in code, pick correct expression/condition

commonTrapsQuickList: static variables do NOT re-initialize on every call
pre-increment (++i) vs post-increment (i++) — order of use vs increment differs
unsigned subtraction wraps around instead of going negative
loop condition checked BEFORE every iteration including the first
highYieldPyqLessons: General output-tracing (13/29) is the default — build the variable-table habit until it's automatic and error-free.
Never do more than 1 loop iteration 'in your head' — write it out, GATE traps are specifically designed to break mental shortcuts.
